title: The Lost Box
setting: A busy street with many small shops on a rainy day.

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: Ivan, a tall policeman with a long brown beard and a blue uniform

characters.name: Maya
characters.look: Maya, a woman with short red hair and a green coat

sentences.en: Maya and her husband Ivan go shopping.
sentences.zh: 玛雅和丈夫伊万去购物。
sentences.scene_prompt: Maya, a woman with short red hair and a green coat and Ivan, a tall policeman with a long brown beard and a blue uniform walk down a busy street with shopping bags.

sentences.en: Ivan is a real policeman with a long beard.
sentences.zh: 伊万是一名真正的警察，留着长胡子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a tall policeman with a long brown beard and a blue uniform stands on the street, smiling, with Maya, a woman with short red hair and a green coat beside him.

sentences.en: They like the little shops on this street.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢这条街上的小商店。
sentences.scene_prompt: Maya, a woman with short red hair and a green coat and Ivan, a tall policeman with a long brown beard and a blue uniform look happily into the windows of small shops.

sentences.en: Then a big box falls from a car.
sentences.zh: 这时，一个大箱子从一辆汽车上掉了下来。
sentences.scene_prompt: A big brown box falls from the roof of a passing car as Maya, a woman with short red hair and a green coat and Ivan, a tall policeman with a long brown beard and a blue uniform watch.

sentences.en: The address on it is thirty houses away.
sentences.zh: 箱子上的地址在三十栋房子以外。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a tall policeman with a long brown beard and a blue uniform holds the brown box and points far down the long street of houses, Maya, a woman with short red hair and a green coat beside him.

sentences.en: Now it is raining, and the box is wet.
sentences.scene_prompt: Rain falls on the wet brown box in the arms of Ivan, a tall policeman with a long brown beard and a blue uniform, next to Maya, a woman with short red hair and a green coat.

sentences.en: Without any umbrellas, they carry it there.
sentences.zh: 他们没有伞，就这样把箱子送了过去。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a tall policeman with a long brown beard and a blue uniform and Maya, a woman with short red hair and a green coat walk through the rain carrying the brown box, with no umbrellas.

sentences.en: They laugh: this is the best fun today.
sentences.zh: 他们笑了：这是今天最开心的事。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a tall policeman with a long brown beard and a blue uniform and Maya, a woman with short red hair and a green coat, both soaking wet, laugh together at a front door.
